value.zh-CN: 输入框的当前值，可 `bind:value`。不传时由组件自行管理；单向 `value={x}` 只作初值，要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:value={get, set}`。没有 defaultValue。
value.en-US: Current value of the input, supports `bind:value`. Left out, the component manages it; a one-way `value={x}` only seeds it, and for a fully controlled input use the function binding `bind:value={get, set}`. There is no defaultValue.

data.zh-CN: 候选项的数据源，可以是字符串、数字或对象的数组。对象项用 value 作选中值，label 作展示文本（缺省显示 value），disabled、class、style 与 data-* 字段落在对应的候选行上，class 接受字符串、数组或对象，style 是字符串；节点内容用 item snippet。
data.en-US: Data source of the candidates: an array of strings, numbers or objects. An object item uses value as the picked value and label as its text (value when label is missing); its disabled, class, style and data-* fields go to the matching row, where class takes a string, array or object and style is a string. Use the item snippet for markup.

autofocus.zh-CN: 是否在挂载后自动聚焦输入框。
autofocus.en-US: Whether to focus the input after mount.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉面板被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips automatically when it would be clipped.

defaultActiveFirstOption.zh-CN: 面板打开后是否默认高亮第一个候选项，此时按 Enter 可直接选中。
defaultActiveFirstOption.en-US: Whether the first candidate is highlighted when the panel opens, so that Enter picks it directly.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 挂载时是否默认展开下拉面板；AutoComplete 没有受控的展开状态。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown panel is open on mount; AutoComplete has no controlled open state.

dropdownClassName.zh-CN: 下拉列表的类名，落在 role="listbox" 元素上。
dropdownClassName.en-US: Class name of the dropdown list, applied to the role="listbox" element.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉面板的最小宽度是否等于输入框宽度。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown equals the width of the input.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 下拉列表的内联样式字符串，落在 role="listbox" 元素上。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Inline style string of the dropdown list, applied to the role="listbox" element.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 前缀元素的 id，combobox 与 listbox 的名称引用它；不传时组件在渲染 insetLabel 时生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the insetLabel element, which names the combobox and the listbox. When omitted, the component generates one while an insetLabel is rendered.

loading.zh-CN: 下拉列表是否显示加载动画；为 true 时代替候选项和空内容。
loading.en-US: Whether the dropdown shows a loading spinner in place of the candidates and the empty content.

maxHeight.zh-CN: 下拉列表的最大高度，数字按 px 处理。
maxHeight.en-US: Maximum height of the dropdown list; a number is in px.

motion.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示、隐藏时是否有动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the dropdown animates when it shows and hides.

onSelectWithObject.zh-CN: 布尔属性，不是回调：为 true 时，onSelect 收到去掉内部字段的数据项对象，而不是选中值。
onSelectWithObject.en-US: A boolean attribute, not a callback: when true, onSelect receives the data item without internal fields instead of its value.

position.zh-CN: 下拉面板的位置，可选值同 Tooltip 的 position。未设置时为 bottomLeft，ConfigProvider 的 direction 为 rtl 时为 bottomRight。
position.en-US: Position of the dropdown; the values are those of the Tooltip position. Unset, it is bottomLeft, or bottomRight when the ConfigProvider direction is rtl.

renderSelectedItem.zh-CN: 选中候选项后输入框显示的文本，必须返回字符串；字符串或数字项收到 `{ value, label }`，对象项收到数据项本身。
renderSelectedItem.en-US: The text the input shows for a picked item; it must return a string. A string or number item receives `{ value, label }`, an object item the item itself.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容时是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button when there is content.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉面板上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the dropdown stop propagating.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，只影响展示样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status; it only affects the style.

onChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化或选中候选项时调用。
onChange.en-US: Called when the input text changes or a candidate is picked.

onSearch.zh-CN: 用户输入时调用，参数为输入的文本。
onSearch.en-US: Called as the user types, with the typed text.

onSelect.zh-CN: 选中候选项时调用，参数为选中值；设置 onSelectWithObject 时为去掉内部字段的数据项。
onSelect.en-US: Called when a candidate is picked, with its value, or with the item without internal fields when onSelectWithObject is set.

onClear.zh-CN: 用清除按钮清空内容后调用。
onClear.en-US: Called after the clear button is used.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入输入框时调用一次。
onFocus.en-US: Called once when the focus enters the input.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开输入框时调用一次。
onBlur.en-US: Called once when the focus leaves the input.

onDropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示或隐藏时调用，参数为是否可见。
onDropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the dropdown shows or hides, with its visibility.

prefix.en-US: Snippet for the prefix of the input.

suffix.en-US: Snippet for the suffix of the input.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 输入框内嵌标签的 snippet，只要传入就当作有内容。设置 prefix 或 trigger 时不渲染，也不作为可访问名称。
insetLabel.en-US: Snippet for the inset label of the input; passing it counts as having content. It is not rendered, and does not name the component, when prefix or trigger is used.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除图标的 snippet，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Snippet for the custom clear icon, effective when showClear is true.

emptyContent.zh-CN: data 为空时在下拉面板中显示的内容的 snippet。
emptyContent.en-US: Snippet for the content shown in the dropdown when data is empty.

item.zh-CN: 候选项行内容的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index }`：item 是未经加工的数据项，index 是它在已渲染候选项中的位置；不提供时显示 label。
item.en-US: Snippet for the content of a candidate row, receiving `{ item, index }`: item is the data item as given and index is its position among the rendered items; without it the row shows the label.

trigger.zh-CN: 替换输入框的 snippet。参数含 value、inputValue、placeholder、disabled、autofocus、size、validateStatus、showClear、insetLabelId、onChange（更新输入文本，触发 onSearch 与 onChange 并展开列表）、onClear、onFocus、onBlur、controlAttrs（传给组件的 aria-* 属性，放到自定义触发器的可聚焦元素上）。使用时 id 落在根元素上。
trigger.en-US: Snippet that replaces the input. Its parameters are value, inputValue, placeholder, disabled, autofocus, size, validateStatus, showClear, insetLabelId, onChange (updates the input text, calls onSearch and onChange and opens the list), onClear, onFocus, onBlur and controlAttrs (the aria-* attributes given to the component, for the focusable element of the custom trigger). With it, id lands on the root element.

getNativeElement.zh-CN: 返回根 div，它包裹输入框或自定义触发器。
getNativeElement.en-US: Returns the root div that wraps the input or the custom trigger.
